user.title: Connect MiteMite to TMDB
user.description: Enter your TMDB API key (a v3 API key or a v4 read access token). The region is used to look up streaming availability and the language for titles and descriptions.

search.title: Search for a series
search.description: Search TMDB by title and choose the series to follow. You can add more later from the integration options.

calendars.title: Calendar
calendars.description: Choose the series to show in the MiteMite calendar, with one all-day event for each upcoming episode. Leave everything unselected to skip it. Each series in the calendar costs one more TMDB request per update.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with TMDB
reauth_confirm.description: TMDB rejected the saved API key. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: TMDB could not be reached. Check the network connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
error.no_results: No matching series were found. Try another title or turn off the anime filter.

abort.single_instance_allowed: MiteMite is already configured. Use its options to add or remove series.

add_search.title: Search for a series to add
add_search.description: Search TMDB by title. Series you already follow are left out of the results.

add_calendars.title: Calendar
add_calendars.description: Choose the new series to show in the MiteMite calendar, with one all-day event for each upcoming episode. Leave everything unselected to skip it. Each series in the calendar costs one more TMDB request per update.

remove.title: Remove series
remove.description: Select the series to stop following.

calendars.title: Manage the calendar
calendars.description: Select the series shown in the MiteMite calendar. Series you unselect are removed from it. Each series in the calendar costs one more TMDB request per update.

data.new_episode_days: Days an episode counts as new

data_description.region: Used to look up streaming availability.
data_description.new_episode_days: The New episode sensor stays on for this many days after an episode airs.

error.cannot_connect: TMDB could not be reached. Check the network connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
error.no_results: No matching series were found. Try another title or turn off the anime filter.
error.already_tracked: All the series found are already followed.

get_releases.name: Get releases
get_releases.description: Returns the episodes airing in a range of days, with the titles of their series ready to use in notifications.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First day of the range. Defaults to today.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days in the range, starting from the start date. Defaults to 1, a single day.

get_upcoming.name: Get upcoming releases
get_upcoming.description: Returns the next episodes to air, from today on, with the titles of their series ready to use in notifications.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of episodes to return. Defaults to 5.

refresh_failed.message: MiteMite could not update from TMDB. Check the Home Assistant logs.

not_loaded.message: MiteMite is not loaded. Check the integration in Settings → Devices & services.
